principle: The complete plan covers the whole product. A specific release enables only capabilities with proven source support and accepted evidence; disabled capabilities are explicit, never zero-filled.

conditional_modules.retained_lines: Deferred: create separately reviewed bounded package before enabling

conditional_security_checks.exports_and_embeds: Require LB-18.02 CSV formula-injection cases, export/embedding privacy suppression and LB-12.04/LB-15.04 acceptance only when this module is enabled; base content hardening remains mandatory regardless

phases.exit: Approved concept, issue hierarchy, preserved existing scope and recorded open decisions
required_evidence: Reviewed product, metric, contributor-rights and phase decisions with unresolved choices recorded
Publication receipt with native hierarchy, preserved source boundaries and actual GitHub readback
phases.receiving_roles: Maintainer / product policy and Data / application engineering

phases.exit: Representative accessible journeys and all failure states reviewed using labeled synthetic data
required_evidence: Exact source/build and labeled synthetic fixture scope, including empty, partial, unavailable, privacy and recovery states
Reviewed deterministic results and the required accessible user-journey evidence; no source or participant result inferred from mocks
phases.receiving_roles: UI / application engineering and accessibility review

phases.exit: Read-only sources, replay, reconciliation and source-specific coverage verified; no public rankings
required_evidence: Approved immutable source IDs, event/field permissions, source-use conditions and known history boundaries
Actual read-only source probes, durable replay/deduplication, reconciliation and coverage receipts
Private shadow-output access verified; public rankings remain disabled
phases.receiving_roles: Source/App owner, Data / application engineering and privacy review

phases.exit: Working public journeys, attribution/LOC/triage audits, functional correction controls, disclosed limitations and active operator
phases.not_claimed: Unsupported qualitative recognition or guaranteed service targets
required_evidence: All mandatory public-release packages and first complete product journey accepted for the selected manifest
Exact enabled/disabled metric and optional-module records with source, identity, privacy, methodology and receiving evidence
Host/cost/operating decision, functioning correction receipt, accepted target profile and declared monitoring interval
Independent anonymous journey readback with attribution, freshness, coverage and privacy limits visible
phases.receiving_roles: Product, metric/source, privacy, accessibility and accepted operations roles

phases.exit: Prelaunch staging acceptance, explicit release authority, deployed revision readback, fresh source progress, accessibility/privacy/recovery receipts
required_evidence: Accepted staged artifact, accessibility/privacy/load/recovery evidence and explicit deployment authority
Approved DNS/TLS, actual deployed revision, fresh source progress and independent anonymous board/profile/evidence readback
Actual correction submission receipt, rollback verification and operator acknowledgement
Target measurements report their actual intervals and unresolved results; a short run cannot certify 30-day availability
phases.receiving_roles: Release authority and accepted operations, with independent receiving review

phases.exit: Every in-scope work package completed or explicitly descoped by owner with reason; enabled-capability manifest reconciled; operations handed off
required_evidence: Every in-scope work package accepted or explicitly descoped through a reviewed owner decision with reason
Enabled-capability manifest reconciled with the complete scope and all conditional-module acceptance
Operations handoff accepted; no optional or future expansion silently substituted for unfinished scope
phases.receiving_roles: Program scope authority and the actual receiving owners for each package

checks: Fresh webhook or reconciliation update observed
Stale indicator and rollback procedure verified

proposed_evaluation_targets.target: Under 2 seconds within the declared load and payload envelope
proposed_evaluation_targets.receiving_boundary: LB-19.04 and LB-20.01: measure failures/timeouts and durable confirmation; no acknowledgement before persistence

proposed_evaluation_targets.target: Under 60 seconds for received in-scope events requiring publication
proposed_evaluation_targets.receiving_boundary: LB-19.04 and LB-20.04: retain unpublished events, oldest-pending age and separate upstream lag

proposed_evaluation_targets.target: At least 99.5% of minute observation slots over a complete rolling 30-day window
proposed_evaluation_targets.receiving_boundary: LB-20.01 and LB-20.04: each declared critical anonymous journey returns the correct privacy-safe contract within 10 seconds; missing observations prevent full-window acceptance

proposed_evaluation_targets.target: At most 4 hours from first observed service loss through safe recovery and independent readback
proposed_evaluation_targets.receiving_boundary: LB-18.04, LB-20.01 and LB-20.03: include detection/decision delay, reconciliation and current privacy restrictions

proposed_evaluation_targets.measure: Recovery point objective for public source observations
proposed_evaluation_targets.target: At most 24 hours of acknowledged source observations unrecovered after reconciliation
proposed_evaluation_targets.receiving_boundary: LB-18.04 and LB-20.03: verify actual missing observations; backup age alone is insufficient; privacy/consent/correction state is outside the loss allowance
